mapper.select: SELECT c.card_id, c.card_name, c.card_type, c.card_image_url, c.company_name, c.annual_fee, c.card_issue_url, b.benefit_id, b.benefit_title, b.benefit_summary, b.benefit_description, b.benefit_icon_url, bgd.benefit_grade_id, bgd.grade_id, bgd.type, bgd.amount, bgd.limit_count, bgd.limit_amount, bgd.min_payment, g.grade_id AS grade_id, g.start, g.end, g.total_discount, bc.category_id, cat.category_name, cat.category_id AS category_id, cat.pre_category_id, cat.category_image_url AS category_image_url FROM card c LEFT JOIN benefit b ON c.card_id = b.card_id LEFT JOIN benefit_grade_discount bgd ON b.benefit_id = bgd.benefit_id LEFT JOIN grade g ON c.card_id = g.card_id AND bgd.grade_id = g.grade_id LEFT JOIN benefit_category bc ON b.benefit_id = bc.benefit_id LEFT JOIN category cat ON bc.category_id = cat.category_id ORDER BY c.card_id, b.benefit_id;

SELECT c.card_id, c.card_name, c.card_type, c.card_image_url, c.company_name, c.annual_fee, c.card_issue_url, b.benefit_id, b.benefit_title, b.benefit_summary, b.benefit_description, b.benefit_icon_url, bgd.benefit_grade_id, bgd.grade_id, bgd.type, bgd.amount, bgd.limit_count, bgd.limit_amount, bgd.min_payment, g.grade_id AS grade_id, g.start, g.end, g.total_discount, bc.category_id, cat.category_name, cat.category_id AS category_id, cat.pre_category_id, cat.category_image_url AS category_image_url FROM card c LEFT JOIN benefit b ON c.card_id = b.card_id LEFT JOIN benefit_grade_discount bgd ON b.benefit_id = bgd.benefit_id LEFT JOIN grade g ON c.card_id = g.card_id AND bgd.grade_id = g.grade_id LEFT JOIN benefit_category bc ON b.benefit_id = bc.benefit_id LEFT JOIN category cat ON bc.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE c.card_id = #{cardId};
SELECT count(*) from card where card_id = #{cardId};
